replacements.source: OpenAI built-in image_gen, new text-only original and self-reference edit
replacements.initialPrompt: Create a brand-new original photorealistic luxury fashion editorial hero, landscape panorama exactly 3072 by 1024 pixels (3:1). No input or reference images. A quiet warm ivory plaster studio with soft late-afternoon sunlight and gentle long architectural shadows. At about 62 percent of image width: a sculptural cream upholstered chair with an unbranded ivory tailored blazer naturally draped over its back, soft cream trousers folded on the seat, and a plain small black leather shoulder bag on the floor beside it. Elegant, subtle texture and realistic fabric details; refined editorial photography, natural low contrast, beige/cream/charcoal palette. Keep the left 42 percent as uncluttered ivory wall/negative space for app copy rendered separately. Keep the main wardrobe grouping within the central-right portion and readable when the panorama is cropped to a near-square mobile frame. No people, faces, bodies, mannequins, text, lettering, brand logos, identifiable designer motifs, signatures or watermarks. Do not imitate a named artist, brand, existing photograph or fashion campaign. This is fictional generic demonstration merchandise, not a depiction of an actual commercial product.
replacements.editPrompt: Edit only this newly generated original fictional fashion still life. Remove the small dangling paper tag/label hanging near the bag and chair, including all tiny marks on that tag, replacing it with the continuous underlying fabric/background. Preserve the entire scene, product shapes, warm ivory colors, lighting, sunlight/shadows, camera framing, uncluttered left text area, and exact panoramic 3:1 aspect ratio. No additional objects, text, signatures, labels or logos. No people or faces. This input is the original text-only output generated for this project, not an outside photograph.
replacements.inputImages: None for initial generation; only that new output for edit. No legacy/reference/Figma image submitted.
